infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Notre Table to keep LIA ready to listen while the app is open, including voice commands, cooking, table mode, and music recognition.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow LIA to recognize voice commands you address to her while Notre Table is open, and to transcribe details you explicitly dictate.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow LIA to search your phone contacts only after you explicitly ask her to call someone.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Notre Table to use your current location when you ask LIA to guide you somewhere.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow LIA to keep turn-by-turn navigation active when Notre Table is temporarily in the background during a trip.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Allow LIA navigation to use motion sensors to improve altitude and routing accuracy during turn-by-turn guidance.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access photos only when you choose a recipe, pantry/fridge image, or profile photo.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera only when you choose to photograph a recipe, fridge, or pantry.
